name: Academy of Performing Arts in Prague
summary: Performing-arts academy in Prague, founded 1945 and home of the FAMU film school; English BAs in acting, photography and dance teaching.

handoff.label: Study programmes in English (BA and MA)

ib.text: No IB points minimum: auditions, portfolios and talent exams decide. AMU's page lists the IB among foreign diplomas it assesses for a small fee; by Czech law it needs no nostrification.

apply.via: AMU online application (one per faculty programme)

Photography: round 2 by video call (assignments and interview)
Authorial Acting audition, 2nd call (31 May–4 June)
Authorial Acting: proof of your diploma due (or 21 days after you finish school)

programmes.name: Authorial Acting
programmes.about: Acting and authorship studied together at the theatre faculty (DAMU): voice, speech, movement and dialogical acting, building towards your own texts and stage presentations rather than interpreting assigned roles.
programmes.ib: No grade minimum: a one-day audition (your texts, movement, voice, speech, improvisation, interview) decides; 40 of 60 points admits.
programmes.selectionNote: Upload a motivation letter and two authorial texts in English with the application; audition in person or online. Your English is judged at the interview.
programmes.closesNote: 2nd call to 16 May 2027, advised for EU applicants

programmes.name: Photography
programmes.about: Photography and visual art at FAMU, the film and TV school: the basics of photographic representation first, then specialised studios and genres, then a bachelor's thesis, with practice and theory side by side.
programmes.ib: No grade minimum: a portfolio of 3–6 projects, then an online round with two assignments and an interview; 40 of 80 points admits.
programmes.selectionNote: Round 1 judges your portfolio (PDF, up to 30 pages) pass/fail; round 2 by video call: a photo assignment, a conceptual assignment and an interview. No fixed cap on places.
programmes.closesNote: Portfolio due 2 December; a spring round may open

programmes.name: Dance Pedagogy - Methods of Classical Ballet Technique
programmes.about: Training to teach dance, with classical ballet technique as the focus: dance methodology and didactics for all ages, other dance styles, dance history, pedagogy, psychology and anatomy.
programmes.ib: No grade minimum: a dance technique exam and written test, then teaching demonstrations and interviews; B2 English and a medical certificate are required.
programmes.selectionNote: Send a CV, cover letter, a teaching video and two written combinations; round 1 (technique, written test) needs 20 of 25, round 2 (demonstrations, interviews) 20 of 25.

family.name: Dance Pedagogy
family.differs: Teaching method built on classical ballet technique.

programmes.selectionNote: Send a CV, cover letter, a teaching video and two written combinations; round 1 (technique, written test) needs 20 of 25, round 2 (demonstrations, interviews) 20 of 25.

notes: Tuition for English-taught study is set each year by the Dean's decree of each faculty and may rise by up to 10% during your studies (DAMU).
Czech law accepts the IB Diploma without nostrification (Act 111/1998, § 48(4)(c)); AMU's page still routes it through its own paid assessment, so ask the faculty which route applies.
Dance Pedagogy expects dance technique at the level of a conservatory graduate, tested in round 1; plan dance training alongside the IB.
